title: Assert main and linked worktree rows in cleanup-report real-Git CLI coverage
outcome: The cleanup-report real-Git fixture proves the Git-discovered main and linked worktree rows and their classifications, in addition to repository and snapshot resolution.
acceptance: The real-Git CLI fixture asserts the main checkout row by canonical identity, its retain classification and main-checkout reason.

The same fixture asserts the linked worktree row, its HEAD and expected outside-repository representation; the assertions discriminate dropped rows or a main root incorrectly classified review across Windows and POSIX path spellings.
